title: First New York nightclub date in 34 years at Michael's Pub
summary: He notes the irony of playing Michael's Pub after 34 years amid honors and academic work.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: It's ironic, also, that here you are in the last few years getting an honorary degree, making a tour of the Middle East for the State -- under the auspices of the State Department, and sort of being an Ambassador of goodwill to other countries, you are playing these universities, you're now in the National Education of Arts Advisory Group, and then in the middle of all this comes your first nightclub date in New York, in how many years?
You suddenly appear in Michael's Pub,
And in the midst of this whole new idea, having to do with more with the intellect and not strictly performance -- in the middle of all this, you go back to the way you began, in a sense.
Not very far from it, either.
So it's not bad, you know? Having all these things going on all at once?
I'm enjoying every bit of it, that's for sure.
That's the note on which we end for the moment.
